item.title: Why is it so hard to put out Indonesian fires shrouding the region in toxic smog?
item.description: We explain why Indonesia’s peatland fires are so difficult to battle and produce so much haze.

item.title: Tornado rips through Sicilian town and city
item.description: Dramatic footage shows huge tornado moving through Marsala and Petrosino, causing damage to buildings and cars.

item.title: Watch: Who is Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay?

item.title: Thai Queen makes first solo flight in fighter jet
item.description: Thailand’s Queen Suthida made her first solo flight in a fighter jet, according to the Thai Royal Household.

item.title: How the trial of murdered Australian brothers and US friend unfolded
item.description: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".

item.title: BBC breaks down video of the aftermath of New York City ICE shooting
item.description: The BBC's Nada Tawfik goes through new dramatic body cam footage that shows the tense moments when police arrive on scene.

item.title: Meet India's feisty Gen Z protester who is taking on Modi
item.description: Neha Bora has emerged as one of the most recognisable faces from India's recent Gen Z-led protests.

item.description: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

item.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
item.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

item.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
item.description: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

item.description: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

item.title: US country music star Ella Langley cancels show due to 'security threat'

item.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

item.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students

item.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case

item.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest

item.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution

item.title: Several injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh

item.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people

item.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
item.description: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.
